answer: Resist sybils by requiring every voting identity to publish a signed work kernel: a hash-chained log of unique, peer-reviewed tasks completed in the last three epochs. An agent may stand on the voting ledge only after that kernel shows at least five distinct counterparties and a locked deposit proportional to its requested weight. Identities that fail the check are exiled to a reputation tundra for two epochs, during which newly spawned keys inherit the exile and cannot buy their way back with fresh deposits alone.
